title: What shape do diagonals that bisect at right angles make?
description: A four-sided shape has diagonals that cut each other in half at right angles. Four pairs of matching triangles at the crossing give four equal sides, which makes a rhombus. Keeko doubts that it must be a square.
teaching_notes: One idea: diagonals that bisect each other at right angles make four congruent triangles, so all four sides are equal. Watch for students who name a square from the right angles alone.

source: The diagonals AC and BD of ABCD bisect each other at O at right angles. Show that ABCD is a rhombus.
video_script.why: The child sees that diagonals bisecting each other at right angles make matching triangles, so all four sides are equal and the shape is a rhombus.
video_script.substitution: the book's own shape ABCD whose diagonals AC and BD bisect each other at O at right angles
video_script.anchor: the shape ABCD with its diagonals AC and BD crossing at right angles at O
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks it must be a square because the diagonals meet at right angles, but a square also needs equal diagonals.
video_script.payoff_line: Eigh B C D is a rhombus

final_answer.spoken: eigh B C D is a rhombus

maths_rules: OA = OC and OB = OD because the diagonals bisect each other
the diagonals meet at 90 degrees, so each of the four angles at O is 90
triangle AOB and triangle COB: OA = OC, angle AOB = angle COB, OB common, so they are congruent by SAS and AB = CB
in the same way BC = CD and CD = DA
all four sides are equal, so ABCD is a rhombus
video_script.design: One idea: four matching triangles at the crossing give four equal sides. One shape stays on the board and each pair of triangles is coloured in turn.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about a four-sided shape eigh B C D.
<bookmark mark='diag'/>Its diagonals eigh C and B D cross at O.
<bookmark mark='def'/>They cut each other in half, which is called bisecting.
<bookmark mark='ang'/>They also meet at right angles.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>What shape is eigh B C D?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: a four-sided shape with all four sides ticked equal; two triangles that match exactly

marks.rh: all four sides of a shape are ticked equal

narration: <bookmark mark='rh'/>A rhombus is a four-sided shape with all four sides equal.
<bookmark mark='cong'/>Triangles that match exactly are called congruent.

beats.on_screen: Given: diagonals AC and BD of ABCD bisect each other at O, at right angles
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the diagonals eigh C and B D bisect each other at O.
They meet at right angles.

beats.on_screen: To find: what shape ABCD is, by testing its four sides
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to name the shape by testing its four sides.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: OA = OC and OB = OD; each of the four angles at O is 90°

marks.eq: the halves O eigh and O C, then O B and O D, are ticked
marks.ang: all four angles at O are marked ninety degrees

narration: <bookmark mark='eq'/>Step one, the diagonals bisect each other.
O eigh equals O C, and O B equals O D.
<bookmark mark='ang'/>The diagonals meet at right angles, so each of the four angles at O is ninety degrees.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: in ∆AOB and ∆COB: OA = OC, ∠AOB = ∠COB = 90°, OB common, so ∆AOB ≅ ∆COB by SAS; AB = CB

marks.tri: triangles eigh O B and C O B are coloured
marks.ang: the two right angles at O light up
marks.eq: eigh B equals C B is written

narration: <bookmark mark='tri'/>Step two, look at triangles eigh O B and C O B.
O eigh equals O C, and O B is common.
<bookmark mark='ang'/>Angle eigh O B equals angle C O B, each being ninety degrees.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>By the side angle side rule, the triangles are congruent.
<bookmark mark='eq'/>Matching sides are equal, so eigh B equals C B.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: in the same way ∆BOC ≅ ∆DOC, so BC = CD; and ∆COD ≅ ∆AOD, so CD = DA

marks.one: triangles B O C and D O C are coloured and B C equals C D is written
marks.two: triangles C O D and eigh O D are coloured and C D equals D eigh is written

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Step three, in the same way, triangles B O C and D O C are congruent.
That gives B C equal to C D.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Triangles C O D and eigh O D are congruent too, so C D equals D eigh.

beats.on_screen: Step 4: AB = BC = CD = DA, so all four sides are equal

marks.all: the four sides of the shape are ticked equal
marks.rh: the rule of a rhombus appears beside the shape

narration: <bookmark mark='all'/>Step four, eigh B, B C, C D and D eigh are all equal.
<bookmark mark='rh'/>A four-sided shape with all four sides equal is a rhombus.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Eigh B C D is a rhombus.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks it must be a square, because the diagonals meet at right angles.
<bookmark mark='long'/>But one diagonal can be much longer than the other.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>A square also needs equal diagonals, and we were not told that.
